references.text: The Lord's servant is given as 'a light of the covenant for the people' and shall open the eyes of the blind, a theme fulfilled in John 9:5 and the subsequent healing.
The prophecy that 'the light comes' and that 'the nations shall walk in your light' mirrors Jesus' claim to be the light of the world coming into the world.
In a nearby context, Jesus declares: 'I am the light of the world,' which is a direct parallel to the statement in John 9:5.
Jesus confirms his role as light by saying: 'I have come as a light into the world,' emphasizing the temporary nature of his presence in the world mentioned in 9:5.
The prologue describes Jesus as the light that 'shines in the darkness,' a theme that Jesus himself expands upon when speaking about his time in the world in 9:5.
